name: Luz Yesenia Paez
office: City of Duarte, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: Luz Yesenia Paez is a public utility analyst. Her campaign says she was appointed to the city's Traffic and Safety Commission in 2022 and to its Planning and Economic Development Commission in 2024, where she was nominated as chair by 2025.

In her 2022 campaign, she called for more teen programming, support for local businesses, and a greater public safety presence to reduce crime. Her campaign says she is committed to transparent and responsive leadership. She says she wants to make sure all residents feel heard and represented in city decisions.
